name: This Party Sucks!
source:
It was supposed to be a typical winter solstice festival, but then the truth is sprung upon you: you only have one night to choose your future spouse from among the vampire attendees. Which cold-blooded creature of the night will you marry?

[From [url=https://amarvelous.itch.io/this-party-sucks]itch.io[/url]]
